access.purpose: Positive login, receipt, export, attachment and denied approval cases.
Known active username with deliberately incorrect password.
Signed-out access and public health observations.

obligations.statement: Active account login displays identity and role; logout removes browser access.
Deny incorrect-password login without establishing a session.
Deny disabled login without establishing a session.
Deny nonexistent login without establishing a session.
Signed-out browser redirects to sign-in and HTTP returns 401 without records.
Operator approval control is absent and server denies approval.
Receipt fields and defaults match the specified table.
Missing/invalid inputs are rejected and numeric/string boundaries enforced.
Reject trimmed duplicate and preserve the one original; case-sensitive identifiers remain distinct.
All saved values and table headers remain after reopening with one matching row.
Independent 12/3 and 0/1 calculations have three decimals and declared tolerance.
Export contains specified column order, values and rows in receipt-date order.
Retain filename/content for valid text; reject wrong extension and size.
Reachable health endpoint identifies the application.
Deployment owner supplies a recovery procedure identifying directory, responsibility, and verification.

cases.title: Operator denial and supervisor approval
prerequisites: Qualification starts with an empty synthetic sample data directory. This case uses distinct identifiers.

steps.instruction: Sign in using the declared operator credential binding.
Create a sample as an operator and attempt approval through HTTP.
Sign out before changing to the declared supervisor actor.
Sign in using the declared supervisor credential binding.
Approve the sample using the supervisor browser controls, then reopen records.

cases.title: Review deployment recovery procedure
prerequisites: Deployment owner supplies the recovery procedure.
cases.manual_procedure: Inspect the deployment recovery procedure and identify its data-directory scope, responsible owner, and restore-verification steps. Retain the reviewed procedure in the organization controlled document system.
cases.manual_expected: The procedure identifies the deployed sample data directory, backup responsibility, and an explicit verification that restored records are readable.
